info.title: PokeAPI Word Universal API
info.description: Public REST wrapper for PokeAPI v2, covering read-only Pokemon lookup and catalog workflows.

get.description: Retrieves details for an ability from PokeAPI.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: abilityId
parameters.description: Identifier for the requested ability. Use an ID or name.

schema.description: Identifier for the requested ability. Use an ID or name.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
